quandoUsar: Demos or game areas with a play-money balance where the fun is cashing out before the curve crashes.
Show live motion: an exponential curve drawn every frame, the crash history in chips and the balance counting up to the new value.
Simulations and probability tests, with your own `random` to repeat rounds and `onRoundEnd` to record each result.
quandoEvitar: Do not use with real money or prizes: the balance is play money, the draw runs in the browser with `random` and nothing proves the round was fair.
Use `slide-game` when the result should come out at once, with no decision during the round.
Use `mines-game` when the person decides step by step, at their own pace, with no clock running.

teclado.acao: On the main button, bets, cashes out during the round and bets again; it is the same `<button>` for the whole round, so focus does not leave it.
In the bet field, confirms the value and clamps it between `minBet` and the balance.
Moves through reset balance, bet, ½, 2×, Max, auto cash-out and the main button; the fields are disabled during the round.

acessibilidade: The card is a `<section>` named by `title`, and a `role="status"` region announces the start, cash-out and crash of each round (“Round started…”, “Cashed out at…”, “Crashed at…”).
The chart is `aria-hidden`; the balance has a hidden “Play-money balance” text with the value, and the ½, 2× and Max shortcuts have their own `aria-label`.
When the action is not available, the main button uses `aria-disabled` instead of `disabled`, to stay focusable; all texts are in English.
movimento: The multiplier rises along an exponential curve redrawn every frame, with scales that stretch along with it, like a camera pulling back; the leading dot pulses.

On a crash, the curve and number switch to the danger color, a ring expands from the dot and the number shakes; a cash-out leaves a mark on the curve and the balance counts up to the new value with a “+” that rises.
With “reduce motion” on, the round continues, but the curve advances in a few steps per second, with no pulse, ring or shake.
responsivo: The card goes up to 34rem and is a container: the chart is 13rem to 16.5rem tall depending on width, and the bet and auto cash-out sit side by side from 26rem.
desempenho: During the round, a per-frame callback rewrites the SVG paths directly in the DOM, without rendering React; a `ResizeObserver` redraws the chart when it changes size.
notasIA: The balance is play money and can live in the component (`defaultBalance`) or outside it (`balance` with `onBalanceChange`); `onRoundEnd` reports the bet, crash point, cash-out and payout.
Pass a seeded `random` for tests or replays: it is called once per round, at bet time; `margin` (0 to 0.5) makes early crashes slightly more likely and `maxMultiplier` (50) caps the crash.
The folder brings its own copy of `play-money.tsx` (balance, bet field, button and history); `speed` controls the climb, with the multiplier equal to e^(`speed` × seconds).
